##### Project general facts

Marriott Residences Sheikh Zayed Road is a prestigious residential development offering a home where elegance meets comfort, blending inviting amenities with the world-renowned hospitality of Marriott Hotels. This exceptional project offers a choice of Two, Three-Bedroom, and Duplex Apartments, each crafted for modern sophistication with innovative appliances and contemporary design. Every residence features a modern, open-concept kitchen and living space, a spacious balcony with breathtaking views of Dubai, and large windows throughout that allow ample natural light.

The development offers a vibrant community experience with thoughtfully designed amenities that cater to every lifestyle need. Residents can enjoy a restful space made entirely for them, where elegance and comfort seamlessly combine. The Marriott hospitality ensures an unparalleled living experience with exceptional service and care.

Each residence features calming earth tones throughout, including parquet wooden floors and stone kitchen accents that create a warm and sophisticated atmosphere. The open-concept layouts maximize space and natural light, while equipped kitchens ensure effortless culinary experiences. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a refined living environment that residents will love.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Al Barsha First, a vibrant and well-connected neighborhood in Dubai known for its diverse community and modern amenities. The area features a mix of residential and commercial spaces, making it a popular choice for families and professionals alike. With its wide array of shops, restaurants, and entertainment options, Al Barsha offers a dynamic urban lifestyle that caters to various tastes and preferences.

One of the key highlights of the neighborhood is the iconic Mall of the Emirates, which serves as a major shopping and leisure destination featuring high-end retail outlets, dining options, and the famous indoor ski slope. The area is conveniently located near major highways, ensuring easy access to other parts of Dubai. The neighborhood's strategic positioning provides excellent connectivity to key destinations throughout the city.

The area is home to several parks and recreational facilities, providing residents with ample opportunities for outdoor activities and relaxation. The community combines modern living with a rich community atmosphere, making it an attractive place to live and work. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of urban convenience, vibrant lifestyle, and community charm, offering an unmatched living experience in one of Dubai's most desirable neighborhoods.
